title: Gift Cards: Sell, Issue and Pay with a Code | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A gift card is a code with money on it. The CrestApps gift cards feature lets you sell cards as a product, issue them by hand with your own code and expiry, follow and change every balance with a reason, email a card again, and let buyers pay with the code at checkout, with refunds putting the money back where it came from.

In this video:
• Why gift cards, and how selling, issuing, spending and following fit together
• Selling a gift card as a product and listing it in the shop
• Issuing a card by hand: amount, code, recipient, expiry and message
• A card's page: change the balance with a reason, activity and sending it again
• Buying a gift card, and paying with one at checkout
• Finding cards, filtering by status and the order a card was bought with
• Refunds and cancellations

chapters.title: Issue a gift card by hand
